text:
Auditor-Kevin: Quick check 1: for next week's SOC2 spot-check we need provenance for an RBAC tweak that landed 2025-12-10 affecting service account svc-redwood-processor plus any KMS Decrypts that service used in a +-1h window. What minimal artifacts can you produce?

leo_sec: we can do: git commit patch, kube-apiserver audit entry, RBAC binding diff, and CloudTrail Decrypt events. prefer to deliver CSVs + SHA256 manifest.

Auditor-Kevin: CSV + manifest sounds good. Also want to see who packaged the bundle and timestamps (chain-of-custody).

ryn_oncall: we'll include packaging metadata: uploader, host, process id, and pre-signed url. Also can include a signed manifest (PGP).

ela_dev: fyi the role change came from the automation pipeline. quick timeline: commit authored 2025-12-10T10:05Z by ela_dev, CI applied at 2025-12-10T10:07Z by ci-bot, kube-apiserver recorded request at 2025-12-10T10:07:05Z by user gitops-bot.

leo_sec: sample Splunk query we used to pull decrypts: 
```splunk
index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt userIdentity.arn=\"arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/redwood-svc-role/svc-redwood-processor\" | table _time, eventID, requestID, resources, requestParameters.encryptionContext
```

Auditor-Kevin: If there were KMS grants or cross-account activity, please flag them per-event. auditor needs grantId and requester identity.

ela_dev: early export shows two decrypts at 10:07:12Z and 10:08:01Z. both show AssumedRole arn for svc-redwood-processor and include grantId \"g-3344a\". we'll mark those. sample (redacted): 
```json
{
  \"eventTime\": \"2025-12-10T10:07:12Z\",
  \"eventName\": \"Decrypt\",
  \"userIdentity\": {\"type\": \"AssumedRole\", \"arn\": \"arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/redwood-svc-role/svc-redwood-processor\"},
  \"requestParameters\": {\"encryptionContext\": {\"job\":\"daily-agg\"}},
  \"additionalEventData\": {\"grantId\":\"g-3344a\"},
  \"resources\": [{\"ARN\":\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd1234\"}]
}
```

ryn_oncall: logged an evidence packing job: job id pack-20251210-11. will upload tar to s3://redwood-compliance/audits/soc2/2025-12-10/pack-20251210-11.tar.gz and post presigned link.

Auditor-Kevin: Please also include any vuln/incident notes that reference this RBAC change or the service account in the same day. We need a short blurb linking tickets.

ela_dev: found ticket INF-5011 (privilege review) opened 2025-12-10 12:20 by sec-team, references the binding change. no active incidents. will include redacted excerpt.

leo_sec: retention note: we'll keep the signed bundle in compliance bucket for 90 days accessible, then move to long-term archive (Glacier Deep) for 2 years. include lifecycle policy screenshot.

compliance-bot: evidence packing started (pack-20251210-11). checksum: sha256:9b2f4c8a...

ryn_oncall: uploaded CSV and manifest, presigned urls posted to the task. manifest is GPG-signed; fingerprint: 7A3C 9F2D 11E8 4B2C.

Auditor-Kevin: received. I'll validate hashes and confirm if we need anything deeper (raw logs, TLS connection traces). thanks for the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
